about.title: Про нас
content: NonStopNews is a modern news agency focused on the prompt and objective delivery of news. We cover key events in Russia and around the world, placing special emphasis on accuracy, analytical rigor, and transparency of sources. Our editorial team operates according to high professional standards, providing readers with reliable information and well-considered expert commentary.

The mission of NonStopNews is to provide a trustworthy and continuous flow of information that helps the audience form a comprehensive understanding of current events and make informed decisions in an ever-changing reality.
